name: Button
description: Triggers an action — save, submit, delete, open.
propsSummary: tone: solid accent|danger, soft and ghost neutral|danger (ink), link accent|neutral; the first is the default
pending: boolean - aria-busy, presses ignored, spinner after a second
render: element | function - swaps the rendered element (anchor, router link)
nativeButton: boolean - whether the rendered element is a native button

children.description:
The label. Optional only so a Button can be the `render` element of a
trigger (`<Dialog.Trigger render={<Button />}>Open</Dialog.Trigger>`),
where the trigger's children become the label.

size.description: Control height on the one track: xs 24, sm 28, md 32, lg 40.

fullWidth.description: Make button full width of container

pending.description:
Work started by this button is running. The button sets `aria-busy`
and ignores further presses at once; after a second (`--fui-pending-delay`)
its label fades and a spinner takes its place, and its width holds.

focusableWhenDisabled.description:
Keep a disabled button in the tab order (`aria-disabled` instead of
`disabled`), so keyboard and screen reader users can still reach it and
read why it is unavailable.

nativeButton.description:
Whether the rendered element is a native `<button>`. Inferred from an
element passed to `render` (a `<button>`, or a component without `href`);
pass it when `render` is a function or a component that renders an anchor
without an `href` prop.

tone.description:
Colour. `solid` takes `accent` (default) or `danger`.
Colour. `soft` and `ghost` take `neutral` (default) or `danger`, shown as ink.
Colour. `link` takes `accent` (default, the link ink) or `neutral`.

when: Running an action: save, submit, delete
whenNot: Toggling state — use Switch or Checkbox
Picking an option — use Select or RadioGroup
guidelines: One solid accent button per form or section
Chroma is earned: leave tone at its default unless the action carries that meaning
soft is the neutral secondary; soft and ghost show danger as ink, never a coloured fill
pending while work runs: it ignores presses without disabling the button
render={<a href />} for a link that looks like a button; the anchor keeps its link role
accessibility: Label the action, not the widget

dont.reason: Do not use a Button for plain navigation.

examples.name: Solid
examples.description: The one action you want people to take here. Accent tone by default.

examples.name: Soft
examples.description: The neutral secondary: a quiet tint, no border, beside the main action.

examples.name: Ghost
examples.description: No fill, no border — for dense toolbars and repeated rows.

examples.name: Link
examples.description: Reads like a link, behaves like an action.

examples.name: Danger
examples.description: Destructive action people cannot undo: solid chrome, danger tone.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: The one track: xs 24 for in-row actions, sm 28, md 32, lg 40.
examples.code:
<Stack direction="row" gap="sm" align="center" wrap>
          <Button size="xs">Micro</Button>
          <Button size="sm">Small</Button>
          <Button size="md">Medium</Button>
          <Button size="lg">Large</Button>
        </Stack>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Blocks clicks and drops the button out of the tab order.

examples.name: Pending
examples.description: Work is running: presses are ignored at once, the spinner shows after a second.

examples.name: Render
examples.description: render swaps the element; an anchor keeps its link role and takes the look.

examples.name: Long Label
examples.description: Long labels stay on one line; shorten the label or give the button room.
examples.code:
<Button>
          Save the localized account preferences and notify every affected workspace administrator
        </Button>

relations.note: Use Link for navigation without action context
Use Icon inside Button for a leading or trailing glyph
ButtonGroup fuses a Button and an IconButton menu trigger into a split button
